files.content:
// Fixed read-only query; original jsonb canonicalization/order.
export const SNAPSHOT_SQL = "with ids as (select unnest(array['4813e2b2-ad0b-509f-aff2-e8c548745b71'::uuid,'3b9bb032-6ca3-535f-a791-1557f4361b8a'::uuid]) id),
jobs as(select j.* from public.ce_evaluation_job j where conversation_id in(select id from ids)),
jr as(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j) order by j.id),'[]') rows from jobs j),
mr as(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) order by m.evaluation_fingerprint),'[]') rows from public.ce_evaluation_methodology m),
sr as(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) order by s.conversation_id),'[]') rows from public.ce_evaluation_state s where conversation_id in(select id from ids))
select md5(jr.rows::text) jobs, md5(mr.rows::text) methodology, md5(sr.rows::text) ce_state,
(select count(*)::int from jobs) jobs_count,
(select bool_and(status='queued' and attempts=1 and lease_owner is null and lease_expires_at is null) from jobs) jobs_shape,
exists(select 1 from public.ce_evaluation_job j join public.conversations c on c.id=j.conversation_id where j.id='16e0abc4-aa3d-48f8-857b-5ca6f75142ea' and j.conversation_id='4813e2b2-ad0b-509f-aff2-e8c548745b71' and j.company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec' and c.company_id=j.company_id and c.channel_config_id='0405282f-77dc-47cf-8074-99dd3dc6c393') exact_scope,
(select count(*)=2 and bool_and(c.company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec' and c.channel_config_id='0405282f-77dc-47cf-8074-99dd3dc6c393' and public.c3_uat_learning_excluded(c.id) and not public.ce_conversation_evaluable_v1(c.id)) from public.conversations c where c.id in(select id from ids)) scope_all,
public.c3_uat_learning_excluded('4813e2b2-ad0b-509f-aff2-e8c548745b71') learning_excluded,
public.ce_conversation_evaluable_v1('4813e2b2-ad0b-509f-aff2-e8c548745b71') ce_evaluable,
(select enabled from public.ce_automation_runtime where singleton=true) runtime_enabled,
md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.ce_verify_worker_token_v1(text)'::regprocedure)) verifier,
md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.ce_claim_specific_job_v1(uuid,text)'::regprocedure)) claim,
md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.ce_conversation_evaluable_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure)) evaluable,
md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.c3_uat_learning_excluded(uuid)'::regprocedure)) registry,
(select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]')::text) from public.messages x where conversation_id in ('4813e2b2-ad0b-509f-aff2-e8c548745b71','3b9bb032-6ca3-535f-a791-1557f4361b8a')) messages,
(select count(*)::int from public.messages x where conversation_id in ('4813e2b2-ad0b-509f-aff2-e8c548745b71','3b9bb032-6ca3-535f-a791-1557f4361b8a')) messages_count,
(select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]')::text) from public.upstream_call_log x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') models,
(select count(*)::int from public.upstream_call_log x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') models_count,
(select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]')::text) from public.conversation_evaluation_attempt x where conversation_id in ('4813e2b2-ad0b-509f-aff2-e8c548745b71','3b9bb032-6ca3-535f-a791-1557f4361b8a')) canonical,
(select count(*)::int from public.conversation_evaluation_attempt x where conversation_id in ('4813e2b2-ad0b-509f-aff2-e8c548745b71','3b9bb032-6ca3-535f-a791-1557f4361b8a')) canonical_count,
(select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]')::text) from public.ce_local_evaluation_attempt x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') local,
(select count(*)::int from public.ce_local_evaluation_attempt x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') local_count,
(select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]')::text) from public.conversation_evaluation x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') evaluations,
(select count(*)::int from public.conversation_evaluation x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') evaluations_count,
(select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]')::text) from public.hf3_learning_case x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') learning,
(select count(*)::int from public.hf3_learning_case x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') learning_count,
(select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]')::text) from public.ce_training_link x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') training,
(select count(*)::int from public.ce_training_link x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') training_count,
(select md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]')::text) from public.evaluation_training_outbox x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') outbox,
(select count(*)::int from public.evaluation_training_outbox x where company_id='4e0ea9f6-11d5-4968-97f6-f0ed8bf7cfec') outbox_count
from jr,mr,sr;
";
